# ankra_security_compliance_framework (Resource)

Tracks one compliance framework for the organisation: while the resource exists the framework is enabled and scored in the Security Center. Destroying it disables the framework. A framework disabled outside Terraform is planned for re-enabling. Creating it for a framework that is already enabled is refused, so a destroy never disables a framework someone else turned on: import it instead. The counterpart of `ankra security compliance frameworks enable` and `disable`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "ankra_security_compliance_framework" "cis" {
  key = "cis-kubernetes"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `key` (String) Framework key from the catalogue (see the `ankra_security_compliance_frameworks` data source). Changing it replaces the resource.

### Read-Only

- `control_count` (Number) Controls the framework defines.
- `enabled_at` (String) When the framework was enabled.
- `id` (String) The framework key.
- `short_title` (String) Short framework title.
- `title` (String) Framework title.
- `version` (String) Framework version.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Compliance frameworks are imported by key.
terraform import ankra_security_compliance_framework.cis cis-kubernetes
```
